# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — code guards for baggage + cancellation, plus prompt rules for transfer/passenger/communication
- Changes I made:
  - tools.py `book_reservation` + `update_reservation_baggages`: recompute `nonfree_baggages = max(0, total_baggages − free_allowance)` in-body from membership+cabin+npax (cluster: paid-bag miscount, tasks 17/22).
  - tools.py `_free_checked_bag_allowance` helper encoding the policy allowance table + param-doc rewrite (weak-reader knowledge).
  - tools.py `cancel_reservation`: eligibility guard — raise if a flight is flown (transfer) or if NONE of {booked ≤24h, airline-cancelled flight, business cabin, has insurance} (cluster: ineligible cancel, task 37/IFOYYZ).
  - policy.md: (a) use `calculate` for every shown amount + read exact charge/refund from returned payment_history (tasks 11t1/12/23); (b) transfer LAST after finishing other doable requests, and policy-denied ≠ transfer (tasks 11t0/37); (c) add/remove passenger → DENY not transfer, keep passenger count, worked example (tasks 11/17/22).
- Expected effect + why safe: baggage recompute always equals the gold formula → can only match/no-op (verified YAX4DR/passing-12 unchanged). Cancel guard verified on real DB: BLOCKs IFOYYZ (37, wrong write) but ALLOWs Z7GOZK (passing 19, insurance) and K1NW8N (23, ≤24h) — the only passing task in the cancel class (19) is preserved. Prompt edits are additive knowledge/narrowing; no passing task transfers, changes passenger count, or relies on mental-math.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none (first iteration).
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: multi-intent tasks where the user-sim ends early (17/22 execute only part) and "book same flight as my other reservation" (8/25 — needs matching the source reservation's route/flight, and in 25 the user-sim supplied a conflicting route). No safe general tool designed yet.
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration).
- Focus next iteration: if accepted, target the "book-a-copy-of-existing-reservation" cluster (8/25) — consider a composite tool that clones a reservation's flights/route by id — and the early-stop multi-intent completion. If rejected, inspect which of the 3 code/3 prompt edits the RESULT attributes regression to and keep the baggage recompute (lowest risk).

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.450 Δ=+0.200 · fixed={11, 37} · broke={—} · unresolved={12, 23, 25, 8} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them).

## Iteration cand_0002 — payment-mix guard + actionable payment errors + reservation-routing/no-email prompt rules
- Changes I made (file/tool + cluster):
  - tools.py `book_reservation`: in-body PAYMENT-MIX guard — raise if >1 certificate / >1 credit card / >3 gift cards (helper `_payment_method_source`). Cluster: task 12 booked with TWO certificates (gold has no such booking).
  - tools.py `_payment_for_update` (override, used by update_baggages & update_flights): enriched actionable error — on insufficient gift card, LIST the user's gift cards with enough balance + credit cards. Cluster: task 17 (agent used gift_card_6490722 $127<$209; gold uses gift_card_8190333 $280).
  - tools.py `book_reservation`: enriched insufficient-balance error (held vs requested); `payment_methods` docstring now gives the exact 2-key schema (payment_id+amount), forbids type/id, worked example. Cluster: 8/23 wrong-format first call.
  - policy.md: (a) "Locating the right reservation when the user gives no reservation ID" — inspect ALL reservations, match by origin+destination, city→airport map, ask if ambiguous (task 22 modified wrong reservation UM3OG5 vs FQ8APE); (b) no email/text tool → decline, do NOT transfer for it (task 23t1/17).
- Expected effect + why safe: payment-mix guard blocks task 12's invalid 2-cert write → DB should match gold (no Noah booking); BOUNDED — verified it stays SILENT on task 23's valid combo and task 25's ≤1-each bookings, and 11/19/37 book nothing. Enriched errors only change TEXT on already-raising paths (success/deduction path byte-identical) → cannot regress a passing update. Prompt rules are additive knowledge that only activate on no-ID-routing / email requests; passing task 19's correct route-match is unchanged.
- Building on prior RESULTS: cand_0001 ACCEPTED (fixed 11/37, broke nothing). KEPT its baggage recompute + cancel guard untouched; did NOT re-touch cancel_reservation / update_reservation_baggages logic.
- Refuted hypotheses: none disproven yet (only one prior RESULT, an accept).
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 8/25 (same-flight-as-before needs matching a past reservation's flight number; 8 also selects the wrong flight — no safe single edit); 40 (confirm+STOP atomic — user ends conversation before the agent's write turn; unwinnable without breaking the confirmation contract). 17's exact card choice is user-preference-driven — attacked via the enriched error, not a hardcoded card, so flip is probabilistic.
- Plateau signal: n/a (2nd iteration). If this rejects, the payment-mix guard is the lowest-risk keeper (pure policy enforcement, correct regardless); re-examine whether the agent found a valid rebook path on task 12 that still differs from gold.
- Focus next iteration (if any): confirm whether task 12 flipped; if not, investigate whether Noah's separate-reservation booking is excluded for a reason beyond the 2-cert rule (double-booking the same passenger). For 8/25 consider a read helper `find_user_flights_by_route(user_id, origin, destination)` to surface a past flight number.
